_readme: Fukuoka's map pack: the Fukuoka City Subway's three lines, with estimated headways, in the formats and under the file names of Taiwan's real railways, read from this folder alone. Made by tools/fukuoka-map (README.md there). Railways only so far: no base map, ground or people.
